_note: One of the 20 sets of ichava/icon-sets-extras, each refreshed by its own config into files/<set>/ and licenses/<set>/, with its version recorded at upstream.sets.<set>.current_version in the pack's config.json. public/icons/svg/{outline,filled}/<category>/<name>.svg flattened to <slug>-outline/-filled, the stem slugged before the suffix (`!.svg` is committed as `-filled.svg`). The 24px redraws are not vendored. Its LICENSE splits icons (CC0) from website code (MIT), so it is pinned by SHA-256. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 1,552 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
